submission.title: Atlas News Intelligence
submission.blurb: Atlas maps current global stories, clusters the same event across independently owned outlets, and compares how differently primary editorial markets cover it with evidence-backed heatmaps, tone, claims, contradictions, omissions, citations, and source-normalized prominence.
